questions.q: Why are the attention dot products scaled by 1/sqrt(d_k)?
answers: To prevent large dot products from pushing the softmax into regions with extremely small gradients.
Because large d_k makes dot products grow in magnitude and drives the softmax into regions with very small gradients.
